title: Write a method
summary: Ruby: Write a method. Call twice(7). Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A method is a named set of steps. Ruby returns the last expression by default.

blocks.text: Install Ruby 3.1 or later. Save one example as lesson.rb and run ruby lesson.rb in a terminal.

blocks.title: Write a method
blocks.code:
def twice(n)
  n * 2
end
puts twice(4)

blocks.text: The method receives 4 as n. Its final expression gives 8.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the calculation as the last expression if it is the answer.
